Your holdings: SMH is right at its stop at 540, needing immediate attention. Leveraged ETFs like SOXL (-58.32%), MUU (-34.55%), and SPAL (-37.46%) are deep in the red and below their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields and any further signs of a tech sector rebound. Your scanner shows PLTU and PLTR in daily discount, potentially offering value if the market stabilizes.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and respect your stops, especially with leveraged positions in a challenging macro environment.
